claim: CAI-only front, 48 of 50 E. coli K-12 proteins (aceB and thrA excluded, see degenerate_cases), cai_greedy baseline, CodonForge meets or exceeds baseline on all 48.

degenerate_cases.explanation: aceB (NP_418438.1) and thrA (NP_414543.1) contain AGG codons with weight 0 in the ribosomal-protein training corpus. usage.cai is identically 0 for any candidate retaining an AGG codon. The greedy baseline wins by construction on a flat-zero objective regardless of search budget. These proteins are excluded from the gate claim.

reason: The 4-generation comparison on all 50 is in cai_only.json. CodonForge meets or exceeds cai_greedy on 48. aceB and thrA stay at 0 after 20 generations with the stagnation window set to 21, and the designed sequences still contain in-frame AGG. They are excluded. The MFE comparison is not this claim.
